Pop superstar Sabrina Carpenter is the latest musician to receive her own Little Golden Book . Sabrina Carpenter: A Little Golden Book Biography is now available to buy online. Released on Sept. 1, 2026, the biography takes readers on the pop star’s path from a music-loving kid to one of the decade’s biggest talents, as told through easy-to-read text and full-color illustrations. Designed for children while appealing to longtime fans, the picture book tells the story of Carpenter’s childhood in Pennsylvania to her eventual rise to fame.
